correctness.rationale: A local rule preserves X_k exactly iff all admissible input blocks of length k+5 output legal length k+1 words. For k=2 and k=3, nine and seven admissible input neighborhoods give respectively 512 and 128 Boolean masks; complete preservation enumeration leaves 23 and 9. Build labeled directed graph on legal 4-block contexts, determinize reachable context subsets and add the k-zero legality state. BFS exhausts all reachable states and either finds the shortest absent legal output word or certifies equality of every finite image word, hence surjectivity for the compact subshift. Independently reimplemented this full automaton and reproduced all histograms, 5 onto maps in each range and masks 96,258 at k2. For k≥4, a one at one input coordinate has at most one possible output 1 within its radius-two window (otherwise distance≤4 forbidden), forcing exactly zero map or one of five shifts for all k.
